thread:
harper: started canary for rwd-v9-int4 at 16:20 UTC, 1% traffic. baseline fp16 vs int4 A/B. main ask: verify safety-thermostat behavior for mixed slices.
joel: perf looks good (p95 -31%). but we have a slice drift on citation-heavy long-docs: F1-style metric down -5.4% on that slice. global quality -0.6%.
indra: auto-eval flags factuality up +2.2% abs on same slice. sample diffs in s3://redwood-evals/1765554327/v9-int4/diffs.txt. lots of dropped citation tokens ~ mid-doc.
harper: hmm. our thermostat auto-fallback currently triggers on any slice delta <= -5% OR factuality >=2% abs. that would flip this canary immediately.
joel: propose a thermostat tweak: add a traffic-aware deadband and a composite severity score. Deadband: if traffic <2% convert factuality-only alerts to notify-only. Composite severity = max(slice_delta_norm, factuality_norm*1.2, hallucination_norm). trigger rollback if composite <= -0.7 sustained 15m.
evand: typo— I'm evan, small note: better to use percentile windows to avoid one-off bursts. suggest sustain 3 samples out of 5 over a 30m window.
indra: agree on percentile smoothing. also suggest a hard rule: if missing-citation-rate >=1.0% abs at any traffic level -> immediate rollback. that's high severity.
harper: operational plan: pause auto-rollback for factuality for this 1% canary, add a 5% sampling shadow focusing on long-docs, run extended kv-warmup with seq 2k-12k, and add composite-watch with tuning.
joel: commands I'll run:
```
rwctl rollout create --model redwood/v9-int4 --traffic 0.5% --observe 45m --auto-fallback "factuality=false" --notes "safety-thermostat warmup"
rwctl shadow create --model redwood/v9-int4 --traffic 5% --mode sampling --slices long-doc,citations
rwctl watch add --slice long-doc --metrics F1,factuality,missing_citation_rate --window 30m --sustain 15m
```
deploy-bot: [action] rollout created by joel: id rlt-1765554327. canary traffic 0.5% observe=45m. auto-fallback factuality disabled for this step. shadow sampling 5% enabled. report path s3://redwood-evals/1765554327/v9-int4/report.html
evand: I'll instrument the composite severity metric in monitor; weights: slice_delta 0.5, factuality 0.4, hallucination 0.1. sustain rule: 3/5 samples in 30m.
indra: I'll run tokenizer-agnostic diffs and try a small logits-rescale (-1.5%) experiment in shadow to see sensitivity. posting results in ~50m.
eng-oncall: noted. pager rules: page if global quality <= -8% OR missing_citation_rate >=1.0% abs OR hallucination >=4.5% abs sustained 10m. otherwise post to #eng-ml.
harper: thanks. keep replies short and only post new telemetry or decisions. reconvene at 17:05 UTC or earlier if deploy-bot posts auto-fallback.
